content:
The construction is exactly the Stern–Brocot/Stern sequence. Each newly inserted number in \(I_{n+1}\) is the sum of an adjacent pair \((a,b)\) in \(I_n\). The adjacent pairs at depth \(n\) are precisely all ordered coprime pairs \((a,b)\), each appearing exactly once.

Thus each occurrence of \(1973\) is created from a coprime ordered pair \((a,b)\) with
\[
a+b=1973.
\]
The number of such pairs is
\[
\#\{1\le a\le 1972:\gcd(a,1973)=1\}=\varphi(1973).
\]
Since \(1973\) is prime,
\[
\varphi(1973)=1973-1=1972.
\]
All such pairs have depth at most \(1971\), so by \(I_{1000000}\) all possible occurrences have already appeared and no later ones are created.

\[
\boxed{1972}
\]
